mapper.select: SELECT center_code AS centerCode, center_name AS centerName FROM erp_center WHERE center_code <> #{hqCenterCode} ORDER BY center_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_kiosk_license (center_code, key_hash, label, issued_by, device_limit) VALUES (#{centerCode}, #{keyHash}, #{label}, #{issuedBy}, #{deviceLimit})
mapper.select: SELECT license_id FROM erp_bookstore_kiosk_license WHERE key_hash = #{keyHash}
SELECT license_id AS licenseId, center_code AS centerCode, label AS label, device_limit AS deviceLimit FROM erp_bookstore_kiosk_license WHERE key_hash = #{keyHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_kiosk_device WHERE license_id = #{licenseId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_kiosk_device (license_id, token_hash, user_agent) VALUES (#{licenseId}, #{tokenHash}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT d.device_id AS deviceId, l.license_id AS licenseId, l.center_code AS centerCode FROM erp_bookstore_kiosk_device d JOIN erp_bookstore_kiosk_license l ON l.license_id = d.license_id WHERE d.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND l.revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT device_id AS deviceId, user_agent AS userAgent, registered_at AS registeredAt, last_used_at AS lastUsedAt FROM erp_bookstore_kiosk_device WHERE license_id = #{licenseId} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY registered_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_kiosk_device SET last_used_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND (last_used_at IS NULL OR last_used_at < DATEADD(MINUTE, -1, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE())))
